title: Drift
description: A detected mismatch between desired and observed state for one object (Technical Specification SS42-43's reconciliation model: Desired State -> Observe -> Compare -> Drift?). Per-object, not per-tenant: Programme Gate P0's classification (phase-0-architecture-inventory-and-lock.md) found only a primitive tenant-level desired_state/observed_state pair implemented (tenants.desired_state/observed_state) and flagged that real Drift must operate per-object -- this schema is that per-object record.

object_reference.description: Opaque identifier of the specific object within object_type, e.g. a capability_binding_id when object_type=CAPABILITY_BINDING.

desired_state_version.description: The desired-state version this drift was detected against (TenantProvisioning.desired_state_version at detection time).

desired_state_digest.description: Opaque content digest of the desired-state record compared, so two drift records can be checked for referring to the same comparison without re-fetching both sides.

drift_description.description: Human-readable description of what differs, e.g. "binding_mode=DISABLED observed, PRIMARY desired".

safe_to_reconcile.description: Whether the reconciler may fix this drift automatically (Technical Specification SS43 "Safe to fix?") or whether it requires the BLOCKED path and human/operator remediation.

reconciliation_run_id.description: Opaque reference to the ReconciliationRun that resolved this drift, once resolution=RECONCILED.
